## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] No secrets, browsing data, generated binaries, or runtime profiles are committed.
- [ ] Core behavior is not hidden inside UI event handlers.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and defaults are explained.
